headline: PALADIN BEATS GUIDANCE AND DISCOVERS ATLAS URANIUM AT PLS — 4.25% U3O8 Over 3m; LHM Ramp-Up Complete (ASX: PDN)
snippet: Paladin Energy (ASX: PDN) exceeded full-year FY2026 production and sales guidance at Langer Heinrich Mine in Namibia while delivering costs below target — and simultaneously announced a brand-new high-grade uranium discovery called Atlas, located 3.5km south of the flagship Triple R deposit at Patterson Lake South in Canada, with the standout intercept returning 8.0m averaging 1.75% U3O8 including a 3.0m slice at 4.25% U3O8. The dual result — production outperformance plus a near-mine discovery at one of the world's highest-grade uranium projects — positions Paladin as one of the few producers simultaneously delivering on operational and exploration mandates as 440 operable reactors worldwide and 545 more in planning underscore long-cycle uranium demand.

headline: COPPER NEAR $14,000 AS TRUMP'S REFINED TARIFF LOOMS OVERDUE — COMEX 26.6% Above LME; Goldman Sees $14K Breach If Duties Hit
snippet: Copper held near $14,000 per tonne on the LME on Wednesday as the COMEX-to-LME premium reached approximately 26.6% — a fresh record of roughly $2,596 per tonne — while traders braced for a White House decision on 15-30% phased tariffs on refined copper (cathodes, ores, concentrates) that the Commerce Department was to have recommended by June 30 but has not yet delivered. COMEX copper inventories have surged from 80,000 to 650,000 tonnes as importers front-ran potential duties, Goldman Sachs sees copper breaching $14,000 LME once the tariff framework clears, and Antofagasta's just-released H1 2026 report shows Chilean supply already down 9.5% year-on-year — tightening the physical market at exactly the wrong moment.

headline: BRIXTON HITS 5,015 G/T SILVER OVER 20m AT LANGIS — 89,125 G/T CORE in New Cobalt Belt Discovery Zone (TSXV: BBB)
snippet: Brixton Metals Corp. (TSXV: BBB) drilled hole LM-26-377 in the Shaft 6 Southeast area at its Langis Silver Project in Cobalt, Ontario — a previously unmined brownfields zone with no historic underground workings — and returned 20.00 metres grading 5,015 g/t silver, including a 0.65-metre interval of 89,125 g/t silver (the highest bonanza-grade sub-interval reported at Langis to date). The result is 140 metres east of earlier hole LM-26-290 which hit 11.35m at 4,560 g/t silver, and together the two holes confirm a previously unknown high-grade zone within Brixton's 105-hole, 24,017-metre 2026 campaign — its largest drill program ever at the project.

headline: SILVER STORM DRILLS 661 G/T AgEq OVER 3.7m AT SAN MARCOS — 1,461 G/T BONANZA Core; Mexico Silver Restart Delivers (CVE: SVRS)
snippet: Silver Storm Mining Ltd. (CVE: SVRS) released diamond drill results from the San Marcos underground mine at its 100%-owned La Parrilla Silver Mine Complex in Durango, Mexico, where hole IDP-SM-26-003A returned 3.70 metres of 661 g/t AgEq — including a 1.60m interval of 1,231 g/t AgEq — and hole EDP-SM-26-006 cut 15.35 metres at 328 g/t AgEq with a 2.00m sub-interval of 1,461 g/t AgEq. The results come from 93 holes now completed at the complex and are consistent with the bonanza-grade silver-gold mineralization that made La Parrilla one of Mexico's most productive silver mines in its operating years, as the company advances a mine restart from recently permitted surface drill pads.

headline: AWALÉ HITS 43.7 G/T AuEq BELOW BBM PIT — Underground Lode Confirmed; 12-Hole Deep Program, Côte d'Ivoire (TSXV: ARIC)
snippet: Awalé Resources Ltd. (TSXV: ARIC) released the first assay results from deeper drilling at the BBM gold-copper deposit at the Odienné Project in Côte d'Ivoire, where hole BBDD-31 returned 7 metres at 7.21 g/t gold equivalent from 385m depth — including 1m at 43.68 g/t AuEq, the highest grade drilled at BBM to date — while BBDD-30 cut 46 metres at 2.35 g/t AuEq from 364m. The first two holes of a twelve-hole program confirm that the high-grade core of the BBM deposit extends well below the current open-pit mineral resource envelope, opening a meaningful underground growth component at one of West Africa's emerging copper-gold systems.

headline: VIZSLA COPPER: MASSIVE SULPHIDE ZONES HIT AT PALMER VMS IN ALASKA — South Wall Confirmed; Assays Pending (TSXV: VCU)
snippet: Vizsla Copper Corp. (TSXV: VCU) updated on its 10,000-metre 2026 drill campaign at the Palmer Copper-Zinc VMS Project in southeast Alaska, where 5 holes totalling 2,242 metres have intersected thick semi-massive and massive sulphide mineralization in both Zone 1 and Zone 2 of the South Wall Zone using two diamond drill rigs. The fully funded program advances drilling in a district that has historically delivered intercepts exceeding 40 metres at grades above 6% copper equivalent, with assay results from the initial holes pending — a catalyst that could be meaningful for investors tracking the copper-zinc VMS space amid the current tariff-driven copper premium.

headline: URANIUM HOLDS $85 AS AI DATA CENTERS DRIVE NUCLEAR DEMAND — CCJ +4.5%, NXE +5.0%, URA +4.1% on Accelerating Buildout
snippet: Uranium equities surged on July 22 — with Cameco (CCJ) rising 4.51%, NexGen (NXE) up 5.04%, and URA gaining 4.09% — as spot U3O8 held firm at $85 per pound against accelerating AI data center demand that is forecast to push global electricity requirements beyond 1,000 TWh by year-end, the equivalent of Japan's entire annual grid. Nuclear power's baseload reliability is increasingly preferred over intermittent renewables by tech firms seeking long-term power purchase agreements, with analysts at Citi projecting uranium could reach $100-125 per pound through the rest of 2026 as utilities that under-contracted in recent years return to the term market.

headline: AVINO LA PRECIOSA SILVER SURGES 59% IN Q2 — 534,945 AgEq Oz Total; Mill Throughput On Plan (TSX: ASM, NYSE: ASM)
snippet: Avino Silver & Gold Mines Ltd. (TSX/NYSE American: ASM) reported Q2 2026 production of 267,305 silver ounces, 2,178 gold ounces, and 729,929 pounds of copper for a total of 534,945 silver equivalent ounces, with La Preciosa contributing 100,658 AgEq ounces — a 59% increase from Q1 2026 — as development production at the Mexico property scaled up on plan. Overall AgEq ounces were lower than Q2 2025 due to planned mining sequencing into lower-copper-grade areas, though mill throughput across both Avino and La Preciosa remained on plan at 184,293 tonnes for the quarter.

headline: LITHIUM SLIDES 9.78% IN A MONTH TO 143,000 CNY/T — LIT ETF at $66.92; Oversupply Caps Rally Despite Record EV Demand
snippet: Battery-grade lithium carbonate held near 143,000 yuan per tonne this week — down 9.78% over the past month — as visible high inventory levels across Chinese processing facilities and limited appetite for aggressive restocking suppressed prices despite the sixth consecutive year of structural demand growth from EV and energy storage systems. The LIT ETF declined to $66.92, extending a multi-week slide that reflects investor concern that the 2026 supply wave from Australian and Chinese hard-rock producers has not yet cleared, even as the Silver Institute and industry groups flag structural tightening on a 12-to-18-month horizon once current inventory overhangs digest.

headline: GOLD MINERS HIT DOUBLE-DIGIT CORRECTION FROM JANUARY PEAK — Analysts Flag Structural Rebound Case Once Rate Haze Clears
snippet: With gold futures down roughly 10% from July's month-open and sitting approximately 20% below the January 2026 record near $5,000 per ounce, gold mining ETFs GDX and GDXJ have logged double-digit percentage declines as operating leverage cut both ways — compressing margins at mid-tier producers and erasing market cap from explorers already trading thin equity cushions. Multiple top analysts now argue the pullback is a tactical correction within a structural bull market, citing M&A pipeline acceleration, record resource inventories at major producers, and gold still representing 27% of global official reserves versus US Treasuries' 22% share as the rebound case once the July 29 Federal Reserve decision removes near-term rate uncertainty.
